Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.question: ১) A boat runs at 22 km per hour along the stream and 10 km per hour against the stream. Find the ratio of speed of the boat in still water to that of the speed of the stream.
Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.exp:
Speed along the stream = speed downstream = a
= 22 km/hr
And speed against the stream = speed upstream = b
= 10 km/hr.
Now, the speed in still water = (a + b)/2 km/hr
= (22 + 10)/2
= 16 km/hr.
And the speed of stream = (a - b)/2 km/hr
= (22 - 10)/2
= 6 km/hr.
Required ratio = speed in still water : speed of stream = 16:6
= 8:3

Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.question: ২) A boat takes 12 hours to cover 64 km downstream and 8 hours to cover 32 km upstream. Then the speed of the boat in still water is
Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.exp:
Distance covered downstream = 64 km
Time is taken in downstream = 12 hours.
Rate of downstream = distance/time = a = 64 km/12 hours
= 16/3 km/hr.
Distance covered in upstream = 32km
Time is taken upstream = 8 hours.
Rate of upstream = distance/time = b = 32km/8 hours
= 4 km/hr.
Speed in still water = (a + b)/2 = (1/2){(16/3) + 4} km/hr
= (1/2)(28/3)
= 14/3 km/hr.

Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.question: ৩) A man can row 7.5 kmph in still water and he finds that it takes him twice as long to row up as to row down the river. Find the rate of the stream.
Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.exp:
Given that, time is taken to travel upstream = 2 × times taken to travel downstream
When the distance is constant, speed is inversely proportional to the time
Hence, 2 × speed upstream = speed downstream
Let speed upstream = x
Then speed downstream 2x
we have,
1/2(x + 2x) = speed in still water
⇒ 1/2(3x)=7.5
⇒ 3x = 15
⇒ x = 5
i.e., speed upstream = 5 km/hr
Rate of stream = 1/2(2x - x)
= x/2
= 5/2
= 2.5 km/hr.

Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.question: ৪) A boat moves downstream at the rate of one km in 5 minutes and upstream at the rate of 4 km an hour. What is the velocity of the current?
Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.exp:
Speed downstream = 1/(5/60)
= 60/5
= 12 km/hr
Speed upstream = 4/1
= 4 km/hr
velocity of the current = 1/2(12 - 4)
= (1/2) × 8
= 4 km/hr.

Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.question: ৫) The speed of a boat in still water is 15 km/hr and the rate of current is 3 km/hr. The distance travelled downstream in 24 minutes is -
Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.exp:
Speed of a boat in still water = 15 km/hr
Speed of the current = 3 km/hr
Speed downstream = (15+3) = 18 km/hr
Distance travelled downstream in 24 minutes = (24/60) × 18
= (2 × 18)/5
= 7.2 km

Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.question: ৬) The current of a stream runs at the rate of 2 km per hr. A motorboat goes 10 km upstream and back again to the starting point in 55 min. Find the speed of the motorboat -
Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.exp:
Let the speed of the boat in still water=x km/hr
Speed of the current = 2 km/hr
Then, speed downstream = (x + 2) km/hr
speed upstream = (x - 2) km/hr
Total time taken to travel 10 km upstream and back = 55 minutes
= (55/60) hr
= 11/12 hr.
According to question,
10/(x - 2) + 10/(x + 2) = 11/12
⇒ 120(x+2)+120(x−2) = 11(x2 - 4)
⇒ 240x = 11x2 - 44
⇒ 11x2 - 240x - 44 = 0
⇒ 11x(x -22) + 2(x - 22) = 0
⇒ (x -22) (11x + 2) = 0
Since x cannot be negative.
So, x = 22 km/hr.
Hence, the Speed of the motorboat is 22 km/hr.

Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.question: ৭) The speed of a boat in still water is 8 kmph. If it can travel 1 km upstream in 1 hr, what time would it take to travel the same distance downstream?
Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.exp:
Speed of the boat in still water = 8 km/hr
Speed upstream = 1/1 = 1 km/hr.
Speed of the stream = 8 - 1 = 7 km/hr.
Speed downstream = (8 + 7) = 15 km/hr.
Time is taken to travel 1 km downstream = (1/15) hr
= (1 × 60)/15
= 4 minutes.

Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.question: ৮) A train, 800meter long is running with a speed of 78 km/hr. It crosses a tunnel in 1 minute. What is the length of the tunnel (in meters)?
Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.exp:
Let the length of the tunnel = x meter
Then, distance = (800 + x) meter.
Time = 1 minute = 60 seconds.
Speed = 78 km/hr
= 78 × (5/18)
= (65/3) m/s
According to the question,
800 + x = 60 × (65/3)
⇒ 800 + x = 1300
⇒ x = 500 meter.

Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.question: ৯) Two trains each 500 meter long, are running in opposite directions on parallel tracks. If their speeds are 45 km/hr and 30 km/hr respectively, the time taken by the slower train to pass the driver of the faster one is -
Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.exp:
Relative speed = (45 + 30) km/hr.
= 75 km/hr.
= 75 × (5/18) km/hr.
= (125/6) m/s.
We are calculating the time taken by the slower train to pass the driver of the faster one.
Hence, distance = length of the slower train = 500 meter.
Time = 500/(125/6)
= 500 × (6/125)
= 24 seconds.

Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.question: ১০) Two trains are running at 40 km/hr and 20km/hr respectively in the same direction. If the faster train completely passes a man sitting in the slower training 5 seconds, the length of the faster train is -
Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.exp:
Relative speed = (40 - 20) km/hr
= 20 km/hr
= 20 × (5/18) m/s
= 50/9 m/s
Time = 5 seconds.
Distance = (50/9) × 5
= 250/9
= 27(7/9) meter.
Hence, Length of the faster train 27(7/9) meter.

Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.question: ১১) Two trains are running in opposite directions at the same speed. The length of each train is 120 meter. If they cross each other in 12 seconds, the speed of each train (in km/hr) is -
Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.exp:
Distance covered = (120 + 120)
= 240 meter.
Time = 12 seconds.
Relative speed = 240/12
= 20 m/s.
= 20 × (18/5) km/hr.
= 72 km/hr.
The relative speed, in this case, is the sum of the speeds of the trains and each train has the same speed,
speed as each train = 72/2 km/hr.
= 36 km/hr.

Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.question: ১২) A train 108 meter long is moving at a speed of 50 km/hr. It crosses a train 112 meter long coming from the opposite direction in 6 seconds. What is the speed of the second train?
Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.exp:
Distance covered = (108 + 112)
= 220 meter.
Time = 6 seconds.
Relative speed = 220/6 = 110/3 m/s.
= (110/3) × (18/5) km/hr
= 132 km/hr.
50 + Speed of second train = 132 km/hr.
Speed of second train = (132 - 50)
= 82 km/hr.

Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.question: ১৩) How many seconds will a 500-meter long train moving with a speed of 63 km/hr, take to cross a man walking with a speed of 3 km/hr in the direction of the train ?
Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.exp:
Distance = 500 meter.
Relative speed = (63 - 3) km/hr.
= 60 km/hr.
= 60 × (5/18)
= 50/3 m/s.
Time taken = 500/(50/3)
= 30 seconds.

Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.question: ১৪) Two stations P and Q are 110 km apart on a straight track. One train starts from P at 7 a.m. and travels towards Q at 20 kmph. Another train starts from Q at 8 a.m. and travels towards P at a speed of 25kmph. At what time will they meet?
Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.exp:
Assume both trains meet x hours after 7 a.m.
Distance covered by train starting from P in x hours = 20x km.
Distance covered by train starting from Q in (x -1) hours = 25(x -1) km.
Total distance = 110 km.
According to question,
20x + 25(x - 1) = 110
⇒ 45x = 135
⇒ x = 3 hours.
Hence, they meet 3 hours after 7 a.m.
They meet at 10 a.m.

Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.question: ১৫) A train, having a length of 110 meter is running at a speed of 60 kmph. In what time, it will pass a man who is running at 6 kmph in the direction opposite to that of the train -
Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.exp:
Distance = 110 meter.
Since the train and man move in opposite directions, the relative speed
= (60 + 6) km/hr.
= 66 km/hr.
= 66 × (5/18) m/s.
= 110/6 m/s.
Time = 110/(110/6)
= 6 seconds.

Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.question: ১৬) If a man's rate with the current is 15 km/hr and the rate of the current is 1(1/2) km/hr, then his rate against the current is -
Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.exp:
Speed downstream = 15 km/hr
Rate of the current = 1(1/2) km/hr.
Speed in still water = {15 - 1(1/2)}
= 13(1/2) km/hr.
Rate against the current = {13(1/2) - 1(1/2)} km/hr
= 12 km/hr.

Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.question: ১৭) The speed of the boat is still water at 12 kmph. It can travel downstream through 45 kms in 3 hrs. In what time would it cover the same distance upstream?
Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.exp:
Speed of the boat in still water = 12 km/hr.
Speed downstream = 45/3 = 15 km/hr.
Speed of the stream = (15 -12) km/hr.
= 3 km/hr.
Speed upstream = (12 - 3)
= 9 km/hr.
Time is taken to cover 45 km upstream = 45/9 hr.
= 5 hrs.

Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.question: ১৮) A boat goes 8 km upstream in 24 minutes. The speed of the stream is 4 km/hr. The speed of boat in still water is -
Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.exp:
Speed upstream = 8/(24/60)
= 20 km/hr.
Speed of the stream = 4 km/hr.
Speed of boat in still water = (20 + 4)
= 24 km/hr.

Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.question: ১৯) The speed of a boat in still water is 25 kmph. If it can travel 10 km upstream in 1 hr, what time would it take to travel the same distance downstream?
Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.exp:
Speed of a boat in still water = 25 km/hr.
Speed upstream = 10/1 = 10 km/hr.
Speed of the stream = (25 - 10) = 15 km/hr.
Speed downstream = (25 + 15)
= 40 km/hr.
Time taken to travel 10 km downstream = 10/40
= (10 × 60)/40
= 15 minutes.

Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.question: ২০) A boat can travel with a speed of 12 km/hr in still water. If the speed of the stream is 4 km/hr, find the time taken by the boat to go 68 km downstream -
Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.exp:
Speed of the boat in still water = 12 km/hr.
Speed of the stream = 4 km/hr.
Speed downstream = (12 + 4)
= 16 km/hr.
Time is taken to travel 68 km downstream
= 68/16
=17/4
= 4.25 hrs.

Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.question: ২১) A train runs at the speed of 72 kmph and crosses a 250 meter long platform in 26 seconds. What is the length of the train?
Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.exp:
Distance covered in 26 seconds.
= 26 × 72 × (5/18)
= 520 meter.
Length of the train = (520 - 250) meter
= 270 meter.

Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.question: ২২) A train overtakes two persons who are walking in the same direction to that of the train at 2 kmph and 4 kmph and passes them completely in 9 and 10 seconds respectively. What is the length of the train?
Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.exp:
Let the speed of the train be v km/hr.
(v - 2) : (v - 4) = 10 : 9 [speed and time are inversely proportional]
⇒ 9v - 18 = 10v - 40
⇒ v = 22 km/hr.
Length of the train
= (22 - 2) × (5/18) × 9
= 50 meter.

Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.question: ২৩) A train is travelling at 48 kmph. It crosses another train having half of its length, travelling in the opposite direction at 42 kmph, in 12 seconds. It also passes a railway platform in 45 seconds. What is the length of the platform?
Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.exp:
Speed of the first train = 48 km/hr.
Let the length of the first train = 2x meter.
Speed of the second train = 42 km/hr.
Let the length of the second train = x meter.
Distance = (2x + x) = 3x meter.
Time = 12 seconds
Relative speed = 48 + 42 = 90 km/hr.
= 90 × (5/18) = 25 m/s.
3x = 25 × 12
⇒ x = 100 meter.
Length of the first train = 200
Time is taken to cross the platform = 45 seconds.
Speed of first train = 48 km/hr
= 48 × (5/18)
= 40/3 m/s.
Let the length of the platform = y meter.
Distance = 200 + y meter.
⇒ 200 + y = 45 × (40/3)
⇒ 200 + y = 600
⇒ y = 400 meter.

Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.question: ২৪) A train having a length of 270 meter is running at the speed of 120 kmph. It crosses another train running in the opposite direction at the speed of 80 kmph in 9 seconds. What is the length of the other train?
Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.exp:
Relative speed = 120 + 80
= 200 km/hr.
= 200 × (5/18)
= 500/9
Time = 9 seconds
Distance covered = (500/9) × 9
= 500 meter.
Length of the train = (500 - 270) meter.
= 230 meter.

Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.question: ২৫) Two trains, each 100 meter long are moving in opposite directions. They cross each other in 8 seconds. If one is moving twice as fast the other, the speed of the faster train is -
Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.exp:
Relative speed = (100 + 100)/8
= 25 m/s.
Sum of their speeds = 25 m/s.
The ratio of their speeds = 1 : 2
Therefore, speed of the faster train
= 25 × (2/3)
= 50/3 m/s
= {(50/3) × (18/5)} km/hr.
= 60 km/hr.

Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.question: ২৬) A boatman can row 96 km downstream in 8 hr. If the speed of the current is 4 km/hr, then find in what time will be able to cover 8 km upstream?
Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.exp:
Speed downstream = 96 km/hr.
Speed of current = 4 km/hr.
Speed of the boatman in still water = 12 - 4
= 8 km/hr.
Speed upstream = 8 - 4
= 4 km/hr.
Time taken to cover 8 km upstream = 8/4
= 2 hours.

Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.question: ২৭) The speed of a boat in still water is 10 km/hr. If it can travel 78 km downstream and 42 km upstream in the same time, the speed of the stream is
Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.exp:
Let the speed of the stream be x km/hr.
Then,
Speed upstream = (10 - x) km/hr.
Speed down speed = (10 + x) km/hr.
Time taken to travel 78 km downstream = Time taken to travel 42 km upstream
78/(10 + x) = 42/(10 - x)
⇒ 13/(10 + x) = 7/(10 - x)
⇒ 130 - 13x = 70 + 7x
⇒ 20x = 60
⇒ x = 60/20
⇒ x = 3 km/hr.

Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.question: ২৮) A man can row at a speed of 12 km/hr in still water to a certain upstream point and back to the starting point in a river which flows at 3 km/hr. Find his average speed for the total journey.
Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.exp:
Speed of the man in still water = 12 km/hr.
Speed of the stream = 3 km/hr.
Speed downstream = 12 + 3
= 15 km/hr.
Speed upstream = (12 - 3)
= 9 km/hr.
Average speed = (Speed downstream × Speed upstream)/Speed in still water
= (15 × 9)/12
= (15 × 3)/4
= 45/4
= 11(1/4) km/hr.

Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.question: ২৯) A boatman can row 3 km against the stream in 20 minutes and return in 18 minutes. Find the rate of current:
Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.exp:
Speed upstream = 3/(20/60)
= 9 km/hr.
Speed downstream = 3/(18/60)
= 10 km/hr.
Rate of current = (10 - 9)/2
= 1/2 km/hr.

Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.question: ৩০) A boat takes 38 hours for travelling downstream from point A to point B and coming back to point C midway between A and B. If the velocity of the stream is 4 kmph and the speed of the boat in still water is 14 kmph, what is the distance between A and B?
Problems on Boats & Streams, Trains.exp:
Velocity of the stream = 4 km/hr.
The speed of the boat in still water is 14 km/hr.
Speed downstream = 14 + 4 = 18 km/hr.
Speed upstream = 10 km/hr.
Let the distance between A and B be x km.
Time taken to travel downstream from A to B + Time taken to travel upstream from B to C(mid of A and B)
= 38 hours.
⇒ x/18 + (x/2)/10 = 38
⇒ x/18 + x/20 = 38
⇒ 19x/180 = 38
⇒ x/180 = 2
⇒ x = 360 km.
